title: Argentina set up England semi-final with extra-time victory over Switzerland
text:
There was an error

Argentina set up a World Cup semi-final with England after scoring twice in extra-time to beat 10-man Switzerland 3-1 in Kansas City.

Watch England in the World Cup semi-final live on BBC One and BBC iPlayer, Wednesday 15 July, 19:00 BST.
